speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Ghost, be with us all evermore.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Amen. The sand is out. The close is still there, which is more than a river week usually keeps.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am for home. Dinner, and then the garret. I have no errand west today.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And this parish. Come, Alse. He has a stair, and I have a pot.
